svg.title: LangChain Deep Agents: model, tools and research workflow — Duotone
svg.desc: A brief enters Deep Agents. The model requests tool calls, the dispatcher executes tools, and tool-result messages return to the model. When the model makes no more tool calls, it returns a final response. Available tools include configured web search, optional custom computer use or MCP tools, built-in filesystem tools, the task subagent tool, and sandbox execution with a compatible backend. The harness provides context handling, optional planning, configured skills and memory, and the LangGraph runtime with optional checkpoints. LangSmith tracing and evaluation and application logs are separate observability concerns, not mandatory steps in the control loop. A separate Content Writer example shows application-owned Plan and Search, Collect and Index, bounded Deep Agents Synthesize and Write calls, a citation-identity gate with at most two repair passes, and the exported document and run report. Computer use is an optional reference-architecture extension and is not implemented in that example repository. Documentation checked October 20, 2026.
svg.text: Deep Agents, from tool call to research output
A LangChain reference architecture with a bounded content-writing example.
Repeat tool calls until the model can finish
Tool results guide the next turn.
The model can plan, delegate or search as needed.
Each result becomes context for the next decision.
04 CONTENT WRITER · A BOUNDED APPLICATION FLOW
The app owns Search → Collect ordering; Deep Agents runs bounded Synthesize, Write and Repair work.
Repair ≤ 2 passes · unresolved citation errors → failed report
Computer use is an extension, not part of the Content Writer example.
